operation.summary: A photo the owner took with the Portal's camera: every photo watch of the chosen targets checks it right away, as if it had taken it (the Camera tab's path). Answers that take longer than about 25 s finish on the phone and show in the applet. The owner's portal pairing only; this is the portal's one write.

body.name: data_base64
body.description: The photo, JPEG (about 1.4 MB at most after base64; send about 1280 px)

body.name: camera
body.description: Which camera took it: rear (default) or front

body.name: targets
body.description: Agent ids from GET /v1/portal/photo/targets; omitted or empty = all

operation.returns: camera, targets[{id, name, checks[{watch_id, label, kind: check|people|change, status: answered|people_checked|skipped|checking|error, summary (one line for the owner), answers?}]}]
